name: AMA Trader 2
summary: AMA Trader 2 is an Expert Advisor based on Kaufman's Adaptive Moving Average (AMA/KAMA), which dynamically adjusts its sensitivity to market volatility. It generates buy signals when price crosses above the AMA and sell signals when price crosses below, adapting to trending versus ranging conditions. The EA opens positions based on these adaptive trend-following signals with configurable risk parameters.
summary_zh: AMA Trader 2是基于考夫曼自适应移动平均线(AMA/KAMA)的智能交易系统，能够根据市场波动性动态调整灵敏度。当价格上穿AMA时产生买入信号，下穿时产生卖出信号，自动适应趋势和震荡行情。该EA基于这些自适应趋势跟踪信号开仓，并配有可配置的风险参数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是考夫曼自适应移动平均线(AMA/KAMA)，它通过效率系数(ER)和快速/慢速平滑常数来自适应调整移动平均线的灵敏度。入场条件为价格从下方突破AMA线时做多，价格从上方跌破AMA线时做空，这种自适应机制使AMA在趋势行情中更加敏感、在震荡行情中更加迟钝。出场条件通常依赖反向交叉信号或固定的止损/止盈设置，当价格反向穿越AMA时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA提供了手数配置参数，可能支持固定手数或基于资金的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，通过止损设置控制单笔风险，但整体风控依赖参数配置的合理性，缺乏多层防护机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is Kaufman's Adaptive Moving Average (AMA/KAMA), which adaptively adjusts the moving average's sensitivity through the Efficiency Ratio (ER) and fast/slow smoothing constants. Entry conditions are: go long when price crosses above the AMA line and go short when price crosses below it; this adaptive mechanism makes AMA more responsive in trending markets and more sluggish in ranging markets. Exit conditions typically rely on reverse crossover signals or fixed stop-loss/take-profit settings, closing positions when price crosses back through the AMA. Position sizing is handled through configurable lot size parameters, potentially supporting both fixed lots and equity-based dynamic sizing. Money management controls per-trade risk through stop-loss settings, but overall risk control depends on the reasonableness of parameter configuration and lacks multi-layer protection mechanisms.

pros: 自适应移动平均线能根据市场状态动态调整灵敏度，在趋势和震荡行情间自动切换
策略逻辑清晰简洁，基于价格与AMA的交叉信号，易于理解和验证
AMA相比传统MA减少了虚假信号，在震荡市中表现更好
pros_en: Adaptive moving average dynamically adjusts sensitivity based on market conditions, automatically switching between trending and ranging modes
Clear and concise strategy logic based on price-AMA crossover signals, easy to understand and verify
AMA reduces false signals compared to traditional moving averages, performing better in choppy markets
cons: 单一指标策略在复杂市场环境下信号可能不足，缺乏多维度确认
止损止盈为固定点数设置，未考虑ATR等波动性指标进行动态调整
缺乏对新K线的检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Single-indicator strategy may lack sufficient signal confirmation in complex market environments
Fixed pip stop-loss and take-profit do not dynamically adjust based on volatility indicators like ATR
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自动调整风险参数
增加多时间框架确认和成交量过滤，减少虚假交叉信号
添加新K线检查机制和最大持仓限制，防止重复开仓和过度风险暴露
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to automatically adjust risk parameters based on market volatility
Add multi-timeframe confirmation and volume filtering to reduce false crossover signals
Implement new bar check mechanism and maximum position limits to prevent duplicate entries and excessive risk exposure

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性，在高波动行情中止损可能过小导致频繁止损
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同根K线重复开仓，增加风险暴露
单一指标依赖在震荡市中仍可能产生连续亏损信号
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss/take-profit ignores market volatility; stops may be too tight in volatile conditions causing frequent stop-outs
Lack of new bar check may cause duplicate position openings on the same bar, increasing risk exposure
Single indicator dependency can still generate consecutive losing signals in ranging markets
